dish: Fishball mee pok / kway teow mee with handmade fishballs and fish dumplings (her giao) in chilli-vinegar
n: Soon Wah Fishball Kway Teow Mee (Newton)
address: #01-69 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: A Newton fixture since 1977 (started at an Orchard carpark in 1966): big, springy fishballs and fish dumplings hand-made daily, over mee pok tossed in chilli and vinegar — an evening-only stall picked by Daniel Food Diary's 12 Newton stalls and reviewed by Miss Tam Chiak.

dish: Big prawn noodle soup with slow-cooked pork ribs (from S$16), regular prawn mee
n: Newton Tian Xiang Big Prawn Noodle
address: #01-60 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: Newton's prawn-mee specialist: a deep, prawn-shell-and-pork broth poured over springy noodles with giant prawns and fall-apart pork ribs — reviewed by Seth Lui and named in Daniel Food Diary's and HungryGoWhere's Newton stall guides.

dish: Charcoal-grilled BBQ chicken wings with house chilli, satay (open till 3am)
address: #01-76 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: The Newton supper stall for charcoal-grilled chicken wings — glossy, smoky and cheap, with a fiery house chilli, grilling until 3am; reviewed by Daniel Food Diary (and on its 12 Newton stalls list) and in HungryGoWhere's Newton guide.

dish: Bolo bun with butter, egg tarts, satay beef macaroni, baked pork-chop rice, peanut-butter French toast
address: Goldhill Shopping Centre, Thomson Road, Novena, Singapore (unit + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: A retro cha chaan teng opposite United Square (opened 2023 as Hong Kong Day. Cha Kee, since rebranded Hong Kong Cha Kee): booth seats and mosaic floors, fresh-baked egg tarts and butter bolo buns, satay-beef macaroni and baked rice, claypots at dinner — covered by Seth Lui, Daniel Food Diary and HungryGoWhere.
